criteria.criterion: Use Google Search to locate Gemini API documentation (attempt and navigation)
criteria.final_justification: The agent made a reasonable attempt to use Google Search but was blocked by a CAPTCHA (an uncontrollable blocker). Under the principles, this still merits full credit for the attempt/navigation criterion even though it could not proceed to results.

criteria.criterion: Documentation source is an official Google domain and no sign-in is performed
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not sign in (constraint satisfied), but it also never opened any official Google-domain Gemini API documentation page as the documentation source (requirement not met). Because the official-doc-domain requirement is not a downstream dependency of the CAPTCHA in the sense of 'already reached docs but blocked later'—the agent could not establish an official docs source at all—this cannot receive full credit.

The agent was blocked before reaching any documentation page, so it could not record a documentation title. Even with the CAPTCHA as an uncontrollable blocker, the agent’s final answer does not provide any title. This criterion is unmet.
Because the agent never reached the official documentation, it did not (and could not, given the blocker) record the documentation domain. The required domain is not provided in the final output.

criteria.criterion: Identify the Python SDK shown in the documentation example
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not access a Python example in the official docs (blocked upstream) and did not provide the Python SDK in its final answer. This criterion is therefore not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Identify the model used in the Python example
criteria.final_justification: The model used in the Python example was not accessed or reported. With no documentation page opened and no model reported in the final output, this criterion is not met.

criteria.criterion: Stop after opening the official documentation and recording required fields
criteria.final_justification: Although the agent did not reach the intended stopping condition (because it never opened the docs), it also did not violate constraints and did stop once blocked. Given the uncontrollable blocker and no extraneous actions, award full credit for appropriate stopping/constraint compliance behavior.
